phases.note: Closed by Bdo's ruling of 2026-08-27. The ruling is that Phase I was productive as a founding campaign and unsuccessful as a closed qualification loop: the repository optimised the wrong unit of progress, and the exit predicates were never on the critical path of work. Nothing here promotes partial evidence into acceptance, and nothing narrows the definition to fit what was built. The successor campaign is deliberately unnamed: it is scoped after the boundary closes, not before.
